Quick notes: our standard self-serve POC window is 30 days with a complimentary credit cap of $1,500 for PLG signups. For strategic midmarket opportunities we have historically approved supplemental credits and extensions on a case-by-case basis when: 1) there is clear path to purchase (pipeline evidence), 2) the account is blocked by non-product issues (procurement/legal), and 3) the uplift request is modest relative to projected ACV.

MidPulse checks boxes: they already briefed solutions on integration, shared follow-on use cases, and estimate a potential $120k ARR within 12 months. I recommend: 60-day extension + $5k credits, conditional on a signed mutual action plan that includes target metrics and an assigned CS engineer. Would need RevOps sign-off for the credit grant.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Data from RevOps: we can approve a one-time credit supplement up to $5k with an approved justification doc. Extension policy: we can add 60 days to pilot period for strategic deals when Legal/Procurement is the blocker. Requirements I need to move to final approval: 1) a short justification (one pager) summarizing why extension is needed, 2) the MA P (mutual action plan) draft, 3) confirmation that security checklist items are in progress.

I've prepared a template justification — putting it on the HubSpot deal (link) and drafted language for the MA P. If you can get Leah/Procurement to confirm the expected timeline and sign the MA P, we'll queue the credit grant for Rishi's quick sign-off.

—Hannah
